maintenance_owner: Molten component-RPC and Wasm runtime maintainers
immediate_outcome: Both named workloads ran under the four reviewed optimization profiles from reviewed source, three processes each, with per-phase samples recorded.
durable_capability: An in-repo command reproduces these numbers for any host and build profile.

source.profile: Cargo release (optimized), debug information disabled; Wasm compiled by Wasmtime 49.0.5 Cranelift with default optimization settings

decision.supports: A static measured mapping from workload shape to profile: pooling for instance churn, baseline for compute-bound single-instance calls.
decision.does_not_support: A learned selector, a trained artifact, per-request profile switching, production or cross-host performance claims, or gate/release eligibility.

non_claims: not a benchmark receipt or release evidence
no production, cross-host or accelerator comparison
no claim that a profile choice is safe for any workload outside these two
